title: SARIMAX.jl: Open-Source Optimization-Based SARIMAX Modeling in Julia (replication package)
description:
Replication package of the article SARIMAX.jl: Open-Source Optimization-Based SARIMAX Modeling in Julia (International Journal of Forecasting, special issue Advances in Open Source Forecasting Software): the source code of Sarimax.jl at the release commit, the containerized replication environment, the experiment configurations and runners, the mapping of every value printed in the article to its archived record, and the verification report (replication/ijf-2026). The archived experimental results are a separate Zenodo record, linked below.

Sarimax.jl estimates SARIMA and SARIMAX models by formulating them as explicit JuMP optimization problems, with user-selectable objective functions, coefficient constraints, regularization and solvers (local, such as Ipopt, or global, such as SCIP).
